title: Midnight Road
note: Canonical sheet for track 555e3bfff2b5a1c7890c (night-drive synthwave). Wording from the whisper small.en pass; title derived from the chorus hook. The verse sections are split so the palette walks night to dawn. Style: the horizon pack — a road world with a sun that rises on the song's clock, Futura display, italic verse voice, no crack device (nothing in this lyric breaks).

lines.text: 4 AM, the city fades to blue
Open road and all I hear is you
Street lights flicker like a film beneath the tires
Dashboard glowing, every mile is pulling me higher
Windows down, the summer air is rushing in
No one around, just the road and where I've been
The night is almost over, the skyline's falling behind
I feel the morning getting closer, like a signal through the static in my mind
I'm driving home through the neon glow
Heart wide open and the radio low
Hands in the wind, let the whole world know
I'm alive, I'm alive on this midnight road
And when the sunrise breaks the dark alone
I follow every light until it leads me home
Racing with the dawn, oh all the shadows gone
White lines vanish in the mirror one by one
Old regrets are losing ground before the sun
Every breath tastes like a life I haven't lived
Every turn reminds me I've got more to give
The night is almost over, the horizon starts to burn
I feel the morning getting closer
